newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber firm on European buying.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber firm on European buying.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark SIR20 offer prices were firm in late trading on Tuesday following active European buying, dealers said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries were at 57.00-57.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and 56.75-57.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.50-57.00 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
"The Europeans appear to be actively buying SIR20. We have just secured a deal to sell SIR20 to London," one dealer in Jakarta said.
Anothe dealer said enquiries from the United States, Indonesia's largest rubber market, were slow following a public holiday on Monday.
Dealers said high amoniac latex was on offer at 2,260 rupiah/kg in Tangerang and Bandung against the previous 2,350 rupiah due to weak demand. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
